lane: يَأْمُورٌ ; (M, K;) so in all the copies of the K but in the L and other lexicons, ↓تَأْمُورٌ; (TA;) _A certain beast of the sea:_ or, as some say, _a small beast:_ (M:) and _a kind of mountain-goat:_ (M, K:) or _a certain wild beast,_ (K, TA,) or _a beast resembling the mountain-goat,_ (M,) _having a single branching horn in the middle of his head._ (M, TA.) [See يَحْمُورٌ, the _oryx._]
